As a fan of Ariana Grandes older music I was excited to listen to “Yes, And?” as I haven’t had the chance to yet. All things considered it was pretty okay! As usual Ariana’s vocals stunned the track and left me very satisfied, but on the other hand I felt like she could’ve tweaked a lyrics a bit. Many of the lines had me scratching my head confused thinking “well that’s certainly a line” and the hook of “yes, and?” didn’t stick with me all that much. Right in the middle of the positivities and negatives is the beats on this track. Overall they were some solid beats but nothing that had me shaking my hair back and forth or jumping up and down with joy while I listened. All things considered this track was alright but it’s not something I’d add to a playlist, so I’m going to give it a solid six out of ten.
